rows.en: (Yaaay~! The test is finally over~)

Oho, looking that happy...
You must have done really well on the test.

Huh?!
N-no, it's not really like that...

Of course, \p, you wouldn't get
a terrible score on a test I made,
would you?

I-I think it went okay, probably...
Pinon-sensei...

Then I suppose I'll let it slide, just for today.
Go have as much fun as you like.
Thank you very much, Pinon-sensei...

(Pinon-chan's test was hard, so honestly,
I'm not that confident...)
(I hope she won't get mad whatever score I get...)
(Yaaay~! The test is finally over~)

(Pinon-chan's test was hard, so honestly,
I'm not that confident...)

(The Super Chili-Chili Dog at this place
is spicy and delicious, just like always.)

What are you doing in a place like this,
\p?

Oh, Pinon-chan.
I was just eating this shop's chili dog.
A chili dog? What on earth kind of food is that?
You don't know? Then here, have a bite.
Thanks, don't mind if I do...
*Chomp*
Well? Is it good?

rows.notes: The Japanese is the first kana of 'karai' (spicy), completed in c19020; kept as the start of 'spicy'.

rows.en: SPIIIIICYYYYY!!!

Sorry...
I had no idea you couldn't handle spicy food......

Ngh... I'll get you back for this someday,
I swear!!

(Maybe that was a bit mean of me...
But getting me back...?)

(The Super Chili-Chili Dog at this place
is spicy and delicious, just like always.)

Oh, Pinon-chan.
I was just eating this shop's chili dog.

(Maybe that was a bit mean of me...
But getting me back...?)

(Oh no, I left something in the classroom.
I've gotta hurry and go get it!)
Owowowowow...

I am NOT okay!
You made me fall down!
S-sorry, Pinon-chan...

Next time you bump into me, I'll make you pay!
Don't you forget it!!
(I feel bad about what I did to Pinon-chan...)

(If I don't apologize properly, I'll probably
go through hell in Pinon-sensei's class...)

(Oh no, I left something in the classroom.
I've gotta hurry and go get it!)
(I feel bad about what I did to Pinon-chan...)

(If I don't apologize properly, I'll probably
go through hell in Pinon-sensei's class...)

(Hm?
Pinon-chan looks really happy...
I wonder what's up?)
Pinon-chan, did something good happen?

Hehe, we're having gratin for dinner tonight.
I just can't wait, I'm looking forward to it so much...
Huh~, so you like gratin, Pinon-chan?
I absolutely love it...

That creamy flavor spreading in your mouth...
And the Parmesan cheese that gives it richness...
The taste those two play in harmony is just......
Th-that's deep...
Hawaah~, I can't wait~

(Judging by that, if I ever make
Pinon-chan mad, maybe giving her gratin
will fix things...)

I wonder what's up?)

(Phew~, today's EX-Gear training was exhausting.)
Huh, Pinon-chan?

I was watching you all move during class.
It really is something.

Spinning around and turning like that...
Just watching almost made me dizzy.

If you're that interested in EX-Gear,
why not give it a try, Pinon-chan?
Maybe you've got talent.

Are you trying to kill me?!
Absolutely not, no thank you!!

(Pinon-chan's athletic ability is a total disaster,
after all...)
